It is a reminder to seek knowledge and understanding not only of the external world but also of the self and the divine within. The name encourages individuals to cultivate a clear and focused mind, allowing them to perceive the world with a greater sense of awareness and compassion. Ultimately, the name Dristika represents the inner light of consciousness that illuminates the path to enlightenment.
